body.heading: Where in the world is Turkmenistan?
paragraphs: Turkmenistan is a country in Central Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Turkmenistan is Ashgabat.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Turkmenistan speak Turkmen and Russian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Turkmenistan is the Turkmenistani manat.

body.heading: How big is Turkmenistan?
paragraphs: Turkmenistan covers about 488,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Laos.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: In the Karakum Desert, the Darvaza crater has burned with natural gas fire for decades — a glowing 'door' in the sand that lights up the night.
Merv was one of the great Silk Road oasis cities, a crossroads of traders and scholars, whose mud-brick walls and mausoleums still stand in the desert.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Turkmenistan on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
